flow.name: The empty start
flow.words: No fixed shell: the walls, bosses, ribs and brackets one field the optimiser sizes, oil-tight by each column's least height; drawn as one body from that field, exact only where machined; the oil-tight gate beside the drawing; FE, castability, the grade as flow B

steps.label: Set-up
steps.method: 4 mm voxels; nothing fixed but the seats' rings, the mounts and the bolts' bosses; the walls the optimiser's, oil-tight by each column's least height
steps.note: 3.32 kg fixed, 4.41 kg to place, the walls' least 2.51 kg of it

steps.label: Optimisation
steps.method: an existing run, reused: stiffness, every bearing's tilt and bed held; one run, GCMMA with MMA's dual

steps.label: Drawing
steps.method: the whole housing by marching cubes from its one field (no exact shell); the inside, bores, exits and holes cut exact: manifold3d's booleans; the least walls drawn from the exact inside, smooth, in the same field as the optimiser's metal; every metal cube the optimiser placed kept whole, each checked inside the drawing before FE
steps.note: the drawing lost mount-1: not judged
